title: solena amplexicaulis
intro: Solena amplexicaulis, commonly known as the prickly choko or prickly passion fruit, is a climbing vine native to Mexico and Central America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to lower blood pressure and reduce inflammation, making it a potential natural remedy for cardiovascular disease and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Solena amplexicaulis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Solena amplexicaulis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
